newsitem.title: FINLAND: Outokumpu details smelter blast damages.
newsitem.headline: Outokumpu details smelter blast damages.

text.p: Finnish mining and metals group Outokumpu Oy on Monday said it estimated the damages from a weekend explosion at its Harjavalta Metals Oy smelter at 20 to 30 million markka and the nickel output loss at 5,000 tonnnes.
"A preliminary estimate of the equipment and building damages is 20 to 30 million markka," Outokumpu said in a statement after earlier saying the damages would amount to "tens of millions of markka."
The damages and production losses from the Sunday morning blast which injured three employees, two seriously, were covered by insurance, Outokumpu said.

"The repairs will probably take over two months, and the amount of lost nickel production will probably be about 5,000 tonnes," it said, adding that the plant's copper production was now back on stream following a brief interruption.
Nickel production at the plant could continue at about half capacity during the repairs if a safety inspection so permitted, Outokumpu said.
The blast caused no environmental damage, it said.
